review_setup_py: review the setup.py configuration for the dcem package dependencies and metadata
summarize_setup_py: summarize the dcem package setup.py including install_requires and dependency_links
refactor_setup_py: refactor the setup.py to update numpy version constraints or add new dependencies
build_dcem_package: build the dcem python package using setup.py with setuptools and install dependencies
test_setup_py: test the setup.py configuration by running python setup.py check for errors
